definitions.explanation: The act of referring to or touching upon a topic in speech or writing.

examples.japanese: その{件|けん}には{言及|げんきゅう}しなかった。
{大臣|だいじん}は{会見|かいけん}で{辞任|じにん}の{可能性|かのうせい}に{言及|げんきゅう}した。
examples.english: The minister made reference to the possibility of resignation at the press conference.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}では{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}についても{言及|げんきゅう}されている。
examples.english: The report also makes reference to environmental issues.

notes:
FORMS:
{言|げん} (say, words) + {及|きゅう} (reach, extend to) = to extend one's words to (a topic).

COMMON PATTERNS:
Pattern: 〜に{言及|げんきゅう}する (to make reference to ~). The topic being mentioned is marked with に.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜に{言及|げんきゅう}する: to refer to, to mention
- {言及|げんきゅう}を{避|さ}ける: to avoid mentioning
- {具体的|ぐたいてき}に{言及|げんきゅう}する: to refer to specifically
- {一切|いっさい}{言及|げんきゅう}しない: to make no mention whatsoever

USAGE:
{言及|げんきゅう} is formal and commonly found in news, academic, and official contexts. In everyday speech, {触|ふ}れる (to touch upon) or {話|はな}す (to talk about) are more natural.
